text.description:
A charming two double bedroom split level property next to Battersea Park.

Benefiting from eat-in kitchen, a good size reception room with separate dining area, a large bathroom & a loft extension which now makes a spacious principal bedroom featuring an exposed brick wall. Spacious apartment offers over 900 sqft of living space and further benefits from Wandsworth Council tax and parking with resident permit.

This apartment benefits from the peaceful location, only a stone’s throw from Battersea Park and the buzz of Battersea Power Station.
